envelope.description: Adapt code review to durable background admission in its worker

body.title: Adapt code review to durable background admission in its worker
body.summary: Integrate the existing TaskReviewCoordinator and code admission/execution/progress paths with the owner worker and resource-guard writer. Persist unverified input before the acknowledgment, then perform existing route/source/projection/capacity checks and review tasks in that worker. Exercise the adapter through the registry without switching production entrypoints yet.
acceptanceChecks: The durable pending acknowledgment precedes deliberately blocked Git/source admission; no provider call occurs before qualified checkpoint persistence.
Same-input submission replay after lost acknowledgment observes saved work; conflicting pinned input is refused and admission failure persists with actionable diagnostics.
Task attribution, dependency ordering, committed after-block scope, explicit final revision and existing projection limits remain unchanged.
Controller review transitions from pending admission to its first assignment without duplicate admission/execution identities; trusted exchanges and explicit recovery remain valid.
Shared serialized checkpoint updates retain native open intents alongside task feedback/progress and correctly close only disposed leases.

tests.name: src/workflow/code-review/task-review/__tests__/worker-admission.test.ts: durable acknowledgment precedes blocked source qualification and provider dispatch
src/workflow/code-review/task-review/__tests__/worker-admission.test.ts: replay and controller admission-to-assignment retain one execution identity
